Action

1. Complete security verification.

2. Read the errand history in Edvin. 

3. Check the app in Zendesk "Cases by order reference" 

 3a. If you find another Zendesk Ticket that is not "Closed" or "Resolved", and it is related to the same request passenger has in your interaction, please close the current ticket and add your notes to the already existing one. Unless, the customer has a different request now (for example, different dates to rebook or cancellation etc)

4. Verify the order reference & Contact reason fields are correct in Zendesk, otherwise update them and submit.

ATTENTION

  • Be careful with the new flight dates. Current format is MM/DD/YYYY
  • If you update Order reference & Contact reason always click on the button "Refresh flow" at the end of this page to reload Zingtree with the updated information.
